collision_credibility.check: inspect actual frozen fixture primitives and independently test a small analytically known empty cavity/occupied rim witness set against actual collision geoms
collision_credibility.scope: localized parity witnesses, not a universal geometry/contact validation

film_trial_selection.rule: first ascending heldout seed in historical_fast with original FAIL and lead-in PASS; if none, first ascending qualification discordance; if none, first paired trial with no improvement claim

prespecified_receipt.primary_contrast: reference control, lead-in minus original; unchanged

refinement.additional_rule: per profile, add the seed of the PASS and the FAIL row closest to max(worst/limit)=1 among rows with finite hold witnesses; ties by ascending seed, then condition; evaluate both geometries for each union seed
refinement.report: retain all reruns, numerical warnings, missing results and baseline/refined decision flips; do not replace primary outcomes

prespecified_receipt.secondary_contrast: historical_fast control, lead-in minus original; unchanged

statistics.operation_counts: all PASS/FAIL/UNKNOWN/CRASH in planned denominator; conditional binomial Wilson 95% by frozen profile and geometry
statistics.paired_contrasts: show paired contingency and difference; no invented paired interval; any added exploratory interval labeled with its assumptions
